_comment: Ceiling on unresolvable citations in docs/*.md, enforced by tools/validate.py.
BASELINE: 8 when this check was added -- the measured count, so CI went
green on the committed debt and red on any NEW rotted citation.
A docs citation that resolves to nothing degrades to inline code instead of a
link (rewrite_docs in tools/build_site_data.py), so before this file existed
the failure was invisible: the doc rendered, the site built, and nothing
failed. validate.py never read docs/ at all.
It is already ratcheting down as the citations get fixed; this file is kept
at the CURRENT count so a single new one fails CI. When a change REDUCES the
count, lower this in that same change -- validate.py prints the exact figure
to copy. Never RAISE it to make CI pass.
The 3 genuine-rot citations were fixed 2026-10-08 in the wave 8 merge (8 -> 5).
The remaining 5 were [label](../SCHEMA.md) / [label](../AGENTS.md) links to real
repo-root files; both validate.py and build_site_data.py now resolve a ../NAME.md
link when NAME.md exists at the repo root (root_md_target), and the site renders
it as a GitHub blob link, so the budget is 0 (2026-10-12).
